phase.Compute spectrum from raw data (proc1d y).
1-click operation! To change the processing
options, click on the down arrow at right and
choose Configure Standard Processing.

phase.Adjust spectrum phase manually (.ph)
Enter manual phasing mode. Allows you to
adjust the zero and first order correction
terms PHC0 and PHC1.

phase.Calibrate frequency axis manually (.cal)
Before executing this command, expand
the reference peak on the display.
In calibration mode, left-click on the
desired position.

phase.Print active window
Spectrum, integrals, peaks etc. are printed
as shown on the display. You may adjust printing colors
and fonts using the drop-down menu of this button.
In the View Tab, you may define which spectra components
(integrals, ...) are displayed. For formatted plots,
use plot layouts: Command plot.

phase.Export active data or plot window as PDF.
Choose a file name and save the window.
Using the drop-down menu of this button
you may select other grahics formats.

phase.Copy to clipboard (copy).
Copies the selected spectrum, fid, or plot to the system's
clipboard. You can "paste" the copied graphics
into a word processor or a presenter program.

phase.Toggle Perspective [Ctrl D]
show maximized data window

phase.Spectrum display properties.
Toggle the visibility of integrals, peaks, and other
spectra components.
Note: Any of these components can only be displayed when
available, e.g. when peaks were picked before, when
integrals were calculated, when a structure mol file
is available, etc.

phase.Click here to access commands such as
new, open, save, delete, run, and
to terminate TopSpin.
Key shortcut to access this menu: ALT F

phase.Window Switcher
get an overview about open windows and quickly change it

phase.Setup preferences
Allows you to change colors, fonts and many other
properties influencing the behaviour of TopSpin.

phase.Click here to access TopSpin documentation:
Manuals, release letters, functions keys, etc.
Key shortcut to access this menu: ALT H
Hint:Type "ft?" or "help ft" into the
command line to get help for the "ft", etc.
phase.Shift baseline up/down while pressing left mouse button [.sud]
phase.Shift spectrum left and right while pressing left mouse button [shift_lr]
phase.Show full spectrum, reset intensity scale [.all]
phase.Retain expansion and scale when changing dataset [.keep]
phase.Close active or all selected windows
phase.Open selected datasets in multiple display
phase.Return, do NOT save phased spectrum [.ret]
